### iliad-112 (17.384–480)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἐϋκλεές (οὐ μὰν ἧμιν ἐϋκλεὲς ἀπονέεσθαι, 17.415) | "of good fame" | "no credit to us" (the negative carried over to the English frame) | "glorious" (reserved for φαίδιμος and κυδάλιμος), "honourable", "glorious for us"; εὖ + κλέος |
| νηκερδέα βουλήν (17.469) | "a profitless plan" | "a profitless plan" | "unprofitable", "useless", "foolish" (each loses κέρδος); νη- negative + κέρδος "gain", and the table’s κέρδιον "better" is the same root |
| δμῆσις (δμῆσίν τε μένος τε, 17.476) | "the mastering" | "mastery of them" (+ note: how the nouns hang on ἐχέμεν is not certain) | "taming" (kept for ἱππόδαμος "horse-taming"), "breaking", "skill"; μένος keeps the table’s "might" (2.387) |
| ἀρειῇ (πολλὰ δ’ ἀρειῇ, 17.431) | "threats" (singular noun, "with a threat") | "with threats" (+ note: rare word) | "curses", "commands", "praise" (Greek ἀρειή is not ἀρετή); distinct from μειλιχίοισι "gentle" |
| ζεύγλη (ζεύγλης ἐξεριποῦσα, 17.440) | "the yoke-loop" | "the yoke-loop" (+ note: exact part of the harness uncertain) | "yoke-pad", "yoke-cushion", "collar", "trace" |
| θαλερὴ χαίτη (17.439) | "the abundant mane" | "the abundant mane" | "blooming", "luxuriant", "lush"; keeps the table’s θαλερός "abundant" (of tears) |
| ἀτρύγετος of the air (δι’ αἰθέρος ἀτρυγέτοιο, 17.425) | "the unharvested upper air" | "the air that yields no harvest" (+ note: meaning unknown) | "barren", "unresting"; follows ἁλὸς ἀτρυγέτοιο "of the sea that yields no harvest" |
| ὀπάζων (ῥεῖα δ’ ἐπαΐξασκε πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ὀπάζων, 17.462) | "pressing on" | "pressing on" (+ note: object not given) | "pursuing", "driving", "bestowing" (the table’s word for the other sense); ὀπάζω "make follow" |
| ἠΰ (μένος ἠΰ, 17.456) | "good" | "good" (might) | "fresh", "noble", "great"; ἠΰς is the neuter of ἐΰς "good" |
| ἑταῖρος ἀνήρ (17.466) | "a companion, a man" | "a companion" | "a friend" (reserved for φίλος), "a fellow warrior"; ἑταῖρος keeps "companion" |
| ὣς … τις εἴπεσκε / αὐδήσασκεν / ὧδε δέ τις εἴπεσκεν (17.414, 420, 423, iterative introductions) | "used to say / speak / rouse" | "would say / speak / rouse" | "said" (loses the -σκ- iterative); a speech introduction of many unnamed speakers |
| ἄλκιμος υἱός (Διώρεος ἄλκιμος υἱός, 17.429, 17.474) | "Diores’ sturdy son" | "Diores’ sturdy son" | "valiant", "brave"; follows Μενοιτίου ἄλκιμος υἱός "Menoetius’ sturdy son" (11.605) |
| ἐναρίζω (ἀλλήλους ἐνάριζον, 17.413) | "were slaying" | "killed one another" | "stripped" (the strict sense, which the note gives); follows ἐνάριζον "killing" (9.530) |
| Names (17.384–480) | Aeacus’ descendant · Peleus · Automedon · Diores’ son · Alcimedon · Laerces · Haemon | same, "son of …" for patronymics in `i` | the familiar Latinised forms, as for the other names in the table |
